issue.title: New settings page listing upcoming booking reminders
issue.body: Harness test (new screen). Add a new page under Settings where users see the reminder emails scheduled for their upcoming bookings (booking title, attendee, send time), read-only. Empty state when there are none.

pm.summary: New read-only Settings screen for upcoming booking reminders needs the Designer first. The schema has no scheduled-reminder data with a send time, so I need one decision on the data source.
acceptance_criteria: A new page is reachable from the Settings navigation with a clear title and description.
The page lists reminder emails scheduled for the signed-in user's upcoming bookings only, with booking title, attendee and send time for each row.
Send times are shown in the user's timezone and date/time format.
Rows are ordered by send time, soonest first.
Reminders for past, cancelled or rejected bookings are not shown.
The page is read-only: no edit, delete or create controls.
When there are no upcoming reminders, an empty state with explanatory text is shown instead of an empty list.
A user never sees reminders belonging to other users' bookings.
All user-facing strings are in the English locale file.
Page is covered by tests for the list, empty state and access scoping.
questions: The schema has no model of scheduled reminder emails (only ReminderMail, with no send time). Should the send time be computed from a fixed rule, such as 24h before the booking start, or should we surface an existing scheduler's data if you have one?
Should the list include reminders sent to the user as organizer only, or also bookings where the user is an attendee?
